retrievalProfile.description: A centered, warm-toned facial portrait emerging from a deep black vignette with soft-focus studio lighting.

recipe.visualDefinition: A close-up portrait of a subject centered in the frame, where the edges of the face and hair dissolve into a solid black background through heavy vignetting and soft-focus lighting, creating a warm, intimate atmosphere.
coreVisualRelationships: Warm skin tones contrasting with deep black
Soft light fall-off from center to edges
coreInvariants: Warm, diffused key lighting on the face

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Face is centered, occupying approximately 50% of the vertical frame height.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The eyes of the subject, positioned slightly above the horizontal midline.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Eye path starts at the eyes, moves down to the mouth and hand, then radiates outward into the black void.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Extensive solid black negative space surrounding the central subject on all sides.

colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Low saturation with high value contrast between the central subject and the surrounding darkness.

letterConstructionRules: Variable line weight suggesting a brush or nib
characterSpecificRedesigns: Lowercase 'y' and 'g' have long, sweeping tails
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Single script style used for both artist name and title to maintain intimacy.

candidateDirections.reason: Captures the informal, hand-drawn quality of the original lettering.
Provides the necessary elegance and thin stroke weight.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a soft-focus portrait of a person with warm lighting, centered in the frame, with the edges of the image fading into a deep, solid black vignette.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add centered, hand-lettered style script text in a pale yellow color at the very top and very bottom of the frame.

verificationChecks: Is the background solid black at the edges?
Is the lighting on the face warm and diffused?
Is the text centered and rendered in a thin script?

mustRedesign: Specific facial features of the original subject

mustAchieve: Seamless transition from subject to black background

postGenerationChecks: Ensure no harsh borders between the subject and the black background.
Verify the text is legible but small enough not to distract from the face.
Check that the color palette remains strictly warm (yellows, oranges, browns) and black.
Confirm the focus is softest at the edges of the hair.
recipe.reuseFormula: Take a centered portrait, apply a heavy black radial gradient vignette, and add thin yellow script at the vertical poles.
